pages.text: The $(item)Explore Skyseed$() — the four lands (Forest, Aquatic, Desert, Meadow) ringed around a spare $(item)structure seed$(). One adaptive seed for the wanderer who would rather be surprised.
Ring the four biome seeds around any structure seed you can spare — it is spent to make one Explore Skyseed.

$(bold)Throw it anywhere$()$(br)It reads the biome it lands over and grows that land's island — a desert over desert, a snowfield over snow — but $(bold)always$() with a rare building raised on it, and its loot waiting inside. Different lands, different finds.
